title: TRADE, TRAVEL, AND TOURISM COMMITTEE REPORT and CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION relative to a lease with China Airlines Ltd. for cargo facilities located at 11201…
text:
[Council File 26-1580; CD 11]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
TRADE, TRAVEL, AND TOURISM COMMITTEE REPORT and CATEGORICAL EXEMPTION relative to a lease with China Airlines Ltd. for cargo facilities located at 11201 Aviation Boulevard at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX).
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. CONCUR with the Board of Airport Commissioners' adoption of staff's determination that the requested action is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article III, Class 1(18)(c) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines.
2. APPROVE the one-year Lease, with a one-year extension option, with China Airlines Ltd., and associated building rental rate, for premises located at 11201 Aviation Boulevard at LAX.
3. CONCUR with the Board's action on August 27, 2026, by Resolution No. 28426, authorizing the Los Angeles World Airports Chief Executive Officer, or designee, to execute the Lease with China Airlines Ltd.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The Board of Airport Commissioners reports that the proposed lease will generate approximately $2,630,917 in revenue during the initial lease year and $5,481,178 over the potential two-year term, excluding rental rate adjustments. There is no impact to the General Fund. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - NOVEMBER 28, 2026 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - NOVEMBER 20, 2026
